history.dynasty: Believed to date from the period of the three crowned kings (Cheras, Cholas, Pandyas); Pandya fish symbols found on site
history.summary: CONFIRMED: this is the hill temple at Konganagiri on College Road, Vivekananda Nagar, Tiruppur - the CSV town Tiruppur is correct. AMBIGUITY FLAG: another Murugan hill shrine also called 'Konganagiri' exists - the Vattamalai Muthukumaraswamy Temple near Kangeyam (~40 km away, off the Kangeyam-Dharapuram road) is also locally called Konganagiri; this file documents only the Tiruppur College Road temple. Lord Murugan here is known as Thapas Kumara Swamy, gracing with consorts Valli and Deivanai atop a small hillock (nearly 100 steps for pedestrians, plus a motorable hill route). Belief: built by Kongana Siddhar, one of the 18 Siddhars, who lived on this hill - hence the name Konganagiri. A Thevara Vaippu Sthalam mentioned in Appar's hymns; Saint Arunagirinathar composed Thirupugazh hymns here. Unique features: the yantras are embedded in the pedestal itself at the time of the moolavar prathistha (normally installed at the idol's feet); the miracle of milk offered before the Lord boiling and overflowing without heating is taken as a mark of the temple's sanctity - hence worshipped as 'Pongu Thiru Thalam'. Shrines include Venkatesa Perumal (a rare Murugan-plus-Perumal combination in one temple), Selva Ganapathy and the Navagrahas with their wives and vahanas; the Vakkanai tree is the sthala viruksham, and the hill's pala trees are carried by locals for use in mangala (auspicious) events. Devotees pray here for removal of marriage obstacles, graha doshams and Chevvai (Kuja) dosham.

name: Konganagiri Murugan Temple
town_description: Tiruppur is Tamil Nadu's knitwear and textile export hub in western Tamil Nadu, about 50 km east of Coimbatore, with several ancient Kongu-region temples including the Sukreeswarar temple at Sarkar Periyapalayam and the Avinasiappar temple at nearby Avinashi.

travel.airport: Coimbatore International Airport, about 55 km away, is the nearest airport.
travel.railway: Tiruppur Junction, about 2.5-3 km away (cross the station overbridge onto College Road), is the nearest railhead.
travel.road: College Road, Konganagiri Road, Vivekananda Nagar, Tiruppur 641602; take College Road past Chikkanna Arts and Science College, then a right turn for ~300 m to the hill.

visitor_information.best_time: October to March for pleasant weather.
visitor_information.opening_hours: Sources disagree - 6:00 AM-12:00 noon and 5:00-8:00 PM (tripadvisor, justdial) vs 9:00 AM-12:00 noon and 4:30-6:00 PM (velpu) - verify before visiting.
